plan.title: M5Stack StamPLC · K141
plan.summary: 以 Stamp-S3A 为主控的 DIN 导轨工业控制器，配备 8 路隔离输入、4 路继电器、CAN/RS485 与小尺寸彩屏。
limitations: Manufacturer exterior CAD only; board/display/peripheral runtime unavailable.
No physical hardware measurements; colors are photograph-informed approximations, not calibrated materials.
PCB has no audited complete board layout and is represented only by a visible neutral UNKNOWN placeholder.
External screw heads, terminal block exteriors and Grove mouths are now separate image-measurement parts; their unseen internals and side CAN/RS485 connector details remain unverified.

Back shell is untextured manufacturer CAD; small metal screw heads/inserts and underside detail remain incomplete. Bottom relay-label extent differs between photo and shell CAD and is not a passed dimension claim.
Paper/optical projection is isolated from molded shell; small printed markings and hidden hardware not supplied by source CAD may remain incomplete.
plan.assemblyNotes: Original manufacturer components selected from assembled cluster; other components excluded with reasons. One rigid global transform, no scaling.

facts.label: Paper and optical face isolation
facts.value: Only manually selected original photograph paper/glass ROIs are retained. All molded shell areas, screws, ports, keys and live displays are excluded from photograph projection.
facts.method: Fixed original-pixel masks and independent mm planes; source images are unmodified except alpha and crop. Recess plane selected from manufacturer CAD planar-face audit.
facts.uncertainty: Paper boundary +/-0.3mm; optical cover diameter +/-0.5mm. Printed-paper images do not establish calibrated optics or firmware output.
